mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(code)) FROM currency WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT er.* FROM exchange_rate er INNER JOIN ( SELECT currency_code, MAX(rate_date) AS rate_date FROM exchange_rate WHERE rate_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY currency_code ) latest ON latest.currency_code = er.currency_code AND latest.rate_date = er.rate_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rate (currency_code, rate_to_usd, rate_date, source, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{currencyCode}, #{rateToUsd}, #{rateDate}, #{source}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rate_to_usd = VALUES(rate_to_usd), source = VALUES(source), updated_at = NOW()
